A second shortcut dictates and translates. Teach it the names and terms it keeps getting wrong and they stop coming back. Optional cleanup gets its own key, so your plain shortcut always inserts exactly what you said.

posts.name: PDFly
posts.tagline: The 100% Private, Client-Side PDF Suite
posts.description: PDFly is a free PDF toolkit that processes your files directly in your browser. No uploads. No accounts. No waiting for a server. Merge, split, compress, convert, rotate and manage your PDFs while keeping your files on your device. Built for developers, students, professionals and anyone who works with PDFs regularly.

posts.name: OmniShield
posts.tagline: Stop leaking secrets into AI chat
posts.description: Most AI tools help you talk to AI more. OmniShield helps you stop leaking to AI. ChatGPT extensions organize chats or add sidebars. We mask secrets at send time — inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & Cursor — before they leave your browser. On-device. No prompt upload. API keys,env dumps, JWTs, emails: gone before send. Free core masking. Pro adds OCR, healthcare patterns, block mode. Other launches give you a better assistant. We give you a seatbelt for AI.

posts.name: DropSite
posts.tagline: DropSite is a no-code drag-and-drop website builder
posts.description: A website builder where everything on the page can be dragged, dropped and typed over. Pick a template, move things until it looks right, press publish.

posts.name: BookmarkHell
posts.tagline: One-time AI cleanup for messy Chrome & Edge bookmarks
posts.description: BookmarkHell is a one-time AI cleanup tool for people with years of messy Chrome or Edge bookmarks. Export your bookmarks, upload the HTML file, and let AI remove duplicates and organize links into useful folders. Review and edit the result, then export it back to your browser. No new bookmark manager to adopt, no subscription, and your browser stays untouched until you import the cleaned file.

posts.name: Meeting Price Tag
posts.tagline: See what your meetings really cost, ticking up in real time
posts.description: Meeting Price Tag is a free real-time meeting cost calculator. Enter attendees and average salary (or hourly rate), hit Start, and watch the dollar cost of your meeting tick up every second. Get a shareable summary with cost per minute and per person. 8 currencies, dark/light mode, 100% private (runs entirely in your browser, no signup, no data collected), plus a free embeddable widget for your own site, wiki, or intranet.

posts.name: Session Replay
posts.tagline: Bug reports with the console, network and clicks attached
posts.description: A Chrome extension that captures a screenshot or recording along with the console output, network requests and interactions, then gives you a link. The person reporting never needs an account — open a real report below with no signup.

posts.name: Psychoscope
posts.tagline: Big 5 Personality Assessment made shareable like MBTI.
posts.description: Psychoscope brings the scientific grounding of the Big Five to the visual, shareable experience people love about MBTI. Instead of reducing you to one personality type, your traits become a unique team of animal characters while preserving your exact Big Five scores. Take the test, understand your personality, and share your team. Further, Psychoscope features a comprehensive compatibility test that uses the Big 5 with the option to integrate additional psychological models like attachment.

posts.name: tabteca
posts.tagline: 110 free tools + sessions saved everywhere
posts.description: Tabteca: 110 verified free tools library + session vault for developers. Discover your entire stack (hosting, databases, AI, auth, CI/CD). Save groups of tabs and restore them instantly on any device, any browser. Track what you actually use. Share sessions with your team. No more lost work. No more forgotten tools. Build more. Lose less.

posts.name: Down Is Forever
posts.tagline: An endless faller where you descend into a mind
posts.description: Down Is Forever is a one-touch endless faller set inside the human mind. You play Dr. Anya Rao of the Deepwell Institute, descending through a shifting mindscape in search of the root memory. Steer left and right as you fall, dodge increasingly difficult hazards, collect Echoes and push deeper. The environment changes as you descend and fragments of the mind begin to surface. Built in Godot by a solo developer. Available free on iOS and Android. Every case has a truth. No mind has a floor.

posts.name: AI-Powered Business OS
posts.tagline: Run your business from one AI-powered Notion workspace.
posts.description: Business OS connects the core systems of a small business CRM, sales, projects, tasks, finances, team, KPIs, and operations in one Notion workspace. What makes it different is the AI layer: instead of generic AI, it can work from your connected business context to help find answers, surface what needs attention, and support better decisions.

Built for creators worldwide, with full English and Arabic support. No signup required.

posts.tagline: Free instant photo stickers and 16-expression packs
posts.description: Turn one photo into a free browser-local transparent PNG with no account, then optionally create a consistent 16-expression pack for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord. Platform-ready ZIP formats and pricing boundaries are shown before generation.

posts.tagline: Open-source forms that sync to Google Sheets
posts.description: Build beautiful forms, connect a Google Sheet, and publish. Every submission lands directly in your spreadsheet. Self-host with Docker or try the hosted demo for free.

posts.name: Pip: Family AI Chat
posts.tagline: You stay in control
posts.description: Pip is an AI chat companion made for children and managed by parents. Kids can ask questions, explore interests, work through ideas, and follow their curiosity through friendly conversations. Parents set the rules, shape how Pip responds, review conversation history, and adjust the experience as their child grows. Pip gives children room to explore while helping parents stay informed and in control. It is built for everyday family life. Available now on iOS and Android.

posts.name: ATTENTION, PLEASE.
posts.tagline: Buy some Attention. Grid and price doubles when full.
posts.description: → Every square is equal → Dutch auction: price falls 1% every hour → When the grid is full, its size doubles → The opening price doubles with every expansion → Edition 1 ends at 512 spots Buy your square while you can.

posts.name: Simplify Your Writing
posts.tagline: Shorten your writing fast and maximize your impact
posts.description: This tool shortens your writing and increases the impact of your content, without AI or cost. There are so many AI tools that can summarize content but they take away the original meaning and take time and money to generate over and over. This tool replaces long phrases with short ones, keeping the meaning and structure intact, and doing it fast without any AI. Just straight dictionary lookups. Because it's open source it can be extended too!

posts.name: Kometrics
posts.tagline: Subscription analytics you can talk to
posts.description: Accurate MRR, churn and LTV for SaaS, built from your Stripe, Paddle, Creem or Asaas billing data. Connect in one click, ask Kometrics AI anything about your revenue and get the report behind the answer. Every metric drills down to the exact customers and movements behind it, the API is ChartMogul-compatible so migrating takes minutes, and it all comes along on the iOS app. Try the live demo, no signup. Free until $1,000 MRR, then Kometrics Pro is $19/month.

posts.name: The Money Curriculum
posts.tagline: A plain-English guide to how money actually works.
posts.description: The Money Curriculum: How Money Actually Works, And Why You Were Never Taught It The Money Curriculum is the course you should have had at eighteen: a practical, plain-English walk through budgeting, debt, saving, investing, and the systems that quietly shape financial outcomes for people who were never taught the rules. Written for readers in both the UK and US, with regulatory detail checked and dated for both markets.

posts.name: Sygal
posts.tagline: Convert any document to clean Markdown, 100% local
posts.description: Sygal converts PDF, Word, Excel, images and web pages into clean Markdown and JSON, locally on your Mac or PC. One-time purchase, no subscription.

posts.name: Motoko Base
posts.tagline: Ship your next SaaS without rebuilding the basics.
posts.description: Motoko Base is a production-ready Next.js SaaS starter with authentication, payments, email, database, storage, analytics, monitoring and AI-ready architecture — so you can focus on building your product instead of rebuilding the foundation.
